7.name: Payment Instructions
7.content:
Methods of Payment Accepted by Pinball Engine

All international payments to arcooda.com can be made in one of the following ways:

USD, HKD, EUR, GBP Bank Telegraphic Transfer (T/T)

 

 

Name of Bank:

The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation

Address of Bank:

1 Queen's Road, Central, Hong Kong

For credit to:

ARCOODA.COM LTD.

Account No.:

Please contact our sales staff for account number.

Swift Code:

HSBC HKHH HKH

 

(Please indicate your company and address on the wire, and fax Pinball Engine a copy at +852-2787 0099)

 

Western Union

 

 

Made out to:

ARCOODA.COM LTD.

Mail to:

Flat 17D, Skyline Tower, 14-18 Tong Mi Road, Kowloon, Hong Kong

 

International Money Order

 

 

Made out to:

ARCOODA.COM LTD.

Mail to:

Flat 17D, Skyline Tower, 14-18 Tong Mi Road, Kowloon, Hong Kong

We may need approximately 30 days to process the money order. This will cause a delay on your shipment.
 

Thomas Cook

Below is the inward TT bank account details for different currencies. Please send payments to the following account for further credit to ARCOODA.COM LTD.
 

Paypal

   
Recipient Name: account@arcooda.com

We will charge an additional 4.9% of Paypal handling charges on the top of your payment. Please note there is a $500usd limit via this method.

Money Gram

Remittance can transfer to Hong Kong Money Gram agent "Travelex Hong Kong Limited" by providing our company name and details.
